item.title: ICPC recovers N37.44bn, records 55.74% conviction rate in 2025
item.description: THE Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC) recovered ₦37.44 billion and $2.353 million in 2025, while recording a 55.74 per cent conviction rate in its prosecutions, the agency has announced.
